custom_views.name: Live Orders OCC Audit
custom_views.query: SELECT id, order_number, customer_name, status, total_amount, deposit_amount, version, updated_at FROM orders ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 50;

custom_views.name: Active Staff Roles
custom_views.query: SELECT user_id, role, created_at FROM user_roles ORDER BY role, created_at;
